headline: Browser platforms now expose multi-modal and hierarchical biological data interactively
label: Interactive Biological Data Visualization
summary: Web-based tools now let experts filter, compare, and export biological networks, hierarchical profiles, colocalization results, and tissue gene expression…
synthesis: The common thread is browser-based interactivity layered over biological data outputs, with the visualization or query layer as the primary contribution. RingNet provides a web interface with an R backend for multi-modal biological networks, supporting node and edge filtering and SVG/PNG export. MetaTree anchors hierarchical profiles to a shared reference tree for multi-group comparison in an open-source browser platform. COLSTATS, a Shiny platform, integrates 1.65M harmonized GWAS and QTL summary statistics (hg38) to run coloc.abf colocalization interactively. Age effect explorer offers code-free browsing of age- and sex-associated gene expression across 54 GTEx v10 tissues using precomputed linear-model results. The data types differ, so the shared element is interactivity rather than a common data structure. The summaries describe tools rather than new biological findings.
